notes: The subject publishes two distinct adapter-selected ordinary interaction classes and withdraws both using IEEE 1516.1-2025 Unpublish Interaction Class. A fresh IEEE 1516.2-2025 HLArequestPublications query must return the exact HLAreportInteractionPublication NULL response: one HLAinteractionClassList parameter with an empty encoded list. Independent object and directed-publication reports are also checked.

requirements.statement: The federate withdraws publication of both distinct adapter-selected ordinary interaction classes through the standard Unpublish Interaction Class service.
After neither ordinary interaction class remains published, the publication query returns the MIM NULL response containing exactly one HLAinteractionClassList parameter whose encoded list is empty.
